gaps.sentence: The manuscript is too fragile ___ (handle) without gloves.
gaps.explanation: Passive to-infinitive: to be + past participle. The manuscript receives the handling.

gaps.sentence: The experiments ___ (conduct) under strict laboratory conditions last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Last year' fixes past simple passive: were + conducted for the plural subject.

gaps.sentence: The markings ___ (see) with the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: cannot be + seen. The context (astronomy) implies impossibility.

gaps.sentence: These wetlands ___ (threaten) by pollution every single year.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive with the agent introduced by 'by': are threatened by.

gaps.sentence: The finalists ___ (interview) live on air as we speak.
gaps.explanation: 'As we speak' demands the present continuous passive: are being + interviewed.

gaps.sentence: Your contract will ___ for a further twelve months.
gaps.explanation: After 'will', passive = be + past participle: will be renewed.

gaps.sentence: The whole street ___ when the gas main burst.
gaps.explanation: The street was evacuated by others: past necessity had to be + evacuated.

gaps.sentence: He refuses ___ (tell) what to do by people he's never met.
gaps.explanation: 'Refuse' takes a to-infinitive; passive meaning needs to be + told.
